name: relaypay-support-agent
description: Week 6 capstone: production customer support agent for RelayPay (Vapi + Claude Agent SDK + custom MCP server + Supabase)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @relaypay/store && npm run build -w @relaypay/mcp-server && npm run build -w @relaypay/server && npm run build -w @relaypay/evaluation
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/store && tsc --noEmit -p mcp-server && tsc --noEmit -p server && tsc --noEmit -p evaluation && tsc --noEmit -p web
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @relaypay/store && npm run build -w @relaypay/mcp-server && npm run dev -w @relaypay/server
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @relaypay/store && npm run seed -w @relaypay/server
scripts.mcp:smoke: npm run build -w @relaypay/store && npm run build -w @relaypay/mcp-server && npm run smoke -w @relaypay/mcp-server
scripts.test: npm run build -w @relaypay/store && npm run test -w @relaypay/store && npm run test -w @relaypay/server && npm run test -w @relaypay/mcp-server
scripts.evaluate: npm run build -w @relaypay/store && npm run build -w @relaypay/mcp-server && npm run build -w @relaypay/server && npm run build -w @relaypay/evaluation && npm run evaluate -w @relaypay/evaluation
scripts.evaluate:supabase: npm run build -w @relaypay/store && npm run build -w @relaypay/mcp-server && npm run build -w @relaypay/server && npm run build -w @relaypay/evaluation && npm run evaluate -w @relaypay/evaluation -- --supabase
